outcome: Initial readiness timed out at 30 seconds during concurrent Chromium/Edge verification; no browser script error was captured. An immediate isolated diagnostic loaded all local modules and data successfully. Cause remains unconfirmed; final checks run sequentially.

follow_up.finding: Subsequent concurrent browser diagnostics reproduced refused ES-module requests and an inert controller. Controlled Windows connection bursts reproduced resets with the inherited backlog of five and none in three trials with backlog 128. HTTP/1.1 connection reuse was also enabled after a later network-buffer error.
follow_up.limit: The original timed-out run did not capture failed requests, so its exact cause cannot be established retrospectively.
follow_up.current_verification: Three two-browser startup trials passed with installed Chrome and Edge. User reported It now responds after refreshing the repaired application.
